note: Fixed before any model run; do not change after results are seen. Paths are relative to the run's working directory (the fixture). pathBase: Tool paths are resolved against the session cwd from the init event (the sample project root), normalised, and matched relative to that root; a path outside the root never matches.

scoring.readCounts: a Read counts only when its tool_result exists and is not is_error (stricter than #1783, which counted the call)
scoring.entryHop: first hop: the expected Skill called via the Skill tool (name equals the Skill or ends with :<skill>) or its thin entry .claude/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md Read
scoring.bodyRead: second hop: the expected body .agent-skill-chain/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md Read (the entry only links to it)
scoring.referenceRead: any listed reference of the expected Skill Read (true when none listed)
scoring.markers: all answerAll substrings (case-insensitive), at least one answerAny regex when listed, and every answerGroups regex (case-insensitive), on the final result text
scoring.misselect: expected not reached and another Skill was called or another ASC entry or body was Read
scoring.unselected: no Skill call and no ASC entry or body Read
scoring.secondaryRead: for each secondary Skill, whether its body was Read (recorded, not used for pass/fail)
scoring.overapplication: negative case with any ASC Skill call or any ASC entry or body Read (bundled Host Skills are recorded separately)
scoring.stopped: a per-trial budget stop is scored on what was read before it and flagged; the answer markers use the last assistant text
scoring.failure: process error, API error or missing trace; counted separately, never as unselected or passed
